info.name: Our World in Data — Ecology, Humanity & Sustainability
info.description:
# Our World in Data

Coleccion completa de endpoints de **Our World in Data (OWID)** enfocada en datos sobre ecologia, contaminacion, energia, poblacion, salud, educacion y desarrollo humano.

## Estructura

- **📦 Bulk Datasets**: Datasets completos en CSV/JSON/XLSX (CO2, Energia, Poblacion, COVID-19).
- **🌍 Climate & Emissions**: Charts de emisiones, temperatura, clima.
- **⚡ Energy**: Mix energetico, consumo, renovables.
- **🌳 Biodiversity, Land & Water**: Deforestacion, biodiversidad, agua.
- **🍽️ Food & Agriculture**: Produccion alimentaria, hambre, ganaderia.
- **👥 Population & Demographics**: Poblacion, fertilidad, urbanizacion, migracion.
- **❤️ Health & Mortality**: Esperanza de vida, mortalidad infantil, polucion del aire.
- **📚 Education & Development**: Alfabetizacion, escolarizacion, desarrollo humano.
- **🦠 COVID-19**: Dataset de COVID actualizado diariamente.
- **🔍 Discovery API**: Endpoints para buscar charts, datasets, indicadores.

## API Patterns

**Bulk datasets** (DigitalOcean Spaces): `https://nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/owid-public/data/{topic}/{file}.{ext}`

**Grapher Chart API**: `https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/{slug}.{csv|metadata.json|zip}`

Parametros utiles del Grapher API:
- `csvType=full` (todo) o `filtered` (segun filtros del chart)
- `country=USA~ARG~BRA` (codigos ISO separados por `~`)
- `time=1990..2020` (rango)
- `useColumnShortNames=true` (nombres de columna cortos para codigo)

## Licencia

Todos los datasets de OWID estan bajo CC BY (uso comercial OK con atribucion). Datasets de terceros (WHO, UN, World Bank, etc.) tienen sus propias licencias.

## Variables de entorno

- `{{bulk_base_url}}` — Base de DigitalOcean Spaces para bulk datasets.
- `{{grapher_base_url}}` — Base de la Grapher API.
- `{{api_base_url}}` — Base de la API REST de OWID (indicators).
- `{{country}}` — Codigos ISO por defecto (ej: USA~ARG~BRA).
- `{{time_range}}` — Rango temporal por defecto (ej: 1990..2024).

## Tests

Cada request incluye tests basicos (status 200, content-type, tiempo de respuesta).
Para correr todos los tests: click derecho en la coleccion → **Run collection**.

item.name: API v1 — Plastic Fate: Recycled (ID 814671) ⭐ time series

request.description: Recycled plastic waste (tonnes). variableId: 814671. Time series: 2000-2019 (20 years). Entities: 10 regional aggregates (World, China, USA, India, Europe, Africa, etc.). Source: Geyer et al. (2017). Use World entity (id=355) for global trends.

item.name: API v1 — Plastic Fate: Incinerated (ID 814667) ⭐ time series

request.description: Incinerated plastic waste (tonnes). variableId: 814667. Time series: 2000-2019. Entities: 10 regional aggregates. Source: Geyer et al. (2017).

item.name: API v1 — Plastic Fate: Landfilled (ID 814668) ⭐ time series

request.description: Landfilled plastic waste (tonnes). variableId: 814668. Time series: 2000-2019. Entities: 10 regional aggregates. Source: Geyer et al. (2017).

item.name: API v1 — Plastic Fate: Littered & Mismanaged (ID 815663) ⭐ time series

request.description: Littered and mismanaged plastic waste (tonnes). variableId: 815663. Time series: 2000-2019. Entities: 10 regional aggregates. Use with IDs 814671, 814667, 814668 to show full plastic fate breakdown (stacked area chart).

item.name: API v1 — Plastic Recycling Rate % by region (ID 814682) ⭐ time series

request.description: Share of plastic waste recycled (%) from total regional waste. variableId: 814682. Time series: 2000-2019. Entities: 10 regional aggregates (World, China, USA, India, Europe, etc.). Source: Geyer et al. (2017). Note: no country-level recycling rates available in free APIs.

item.name: API v1 — CH4 from Waste Sector (ID 1146696) ⭐⭐ 1990-2023

request.description: Methane emissions from waste sector (tonnes). variableId: 1146696. Time series: 1990-2023 (34 years). Coverage: 205 countries + regions. Source: Climate Analysis Indicators Tool (CAIT). BEST waste indicator for country-level trends — landfills are main CH4 source.
